data.value:
SRP (Philippine / typical market base price): Approx. ₱1,152,000 – ₱1,992,000 (Varies by trim, drivetrain, and configuration)
SPECS:
Overall Dimensions (mm): 5,265–5,360 × 1,865–1,930 × 1,775–1,815 Wheelbase (mm): 3,130 Seating Capacity: 5 (Double Cab)
ENGINE / PERFORMANCE
Engine Options:
2.4 L 4-Cylinder Turbocharged Diesel
Maximum Output: ~181 hp (base/mid variants) Maximum Torque: ~430 Nm
Higher-tuned variants:
Maximum Output: ~201 hp Maximum Torque: ~470 Nm
Transmission: 6-speed Manual or 6-speed Automatic Drivetrain: 2WD (RWD) or 4WD depending on trim
CAPACITY & CAPABILITIES
Towing Capacity: Up to ~3,500 kg (braked, variant-dependent)
Payload Capacity: Approx. 985–1,115 kg (depending on variant)
Fuel Tank Capacity: 75 L
INTERIOR / CABIN / SPACE
Seating: 5
Cargo Bed (Double Cab): Approx. deck length 1,555 mm Approx. deck width 1,545 mm Approx. deck height 525 mm
Infotainment: Touchscreen system available on mid to higher trims, with smartphone connectivity
Speakers: 2–6 (depending on variant)
CHASSIS / BRAKES / WHEELS / SUSPENSION
Front Brake / Rear Brake: Ventilated Disc / Drum or Disc (variant-dependent)
Suspension: Double Wishbone front, Leaf Spring rear
Tires / Wheels: 16”, 17”, or 18” wheels depending on trim
Ground Clearance: Approx. 203–222 mm (variant-dependent)
